summary: Round-2 (strategy settings + price alerts + push) backend: 11/11 pytest pass against public preview URL. Frontend: strategy-settings-screen fully verified end-to-end (stepper +/-, dirty state 'Save rules' vs 'No changes', reset button appears only when non-default and restores to defaults, params persist across setup labels). Price alert sheet on BTC setup detail fully verified: condition above/below, quick-5 chip, target input, wrong-side validation ('For "below", pick a price lower than now' error toast), create → success toast ('Alert set: BTC above $87,161') → price-alert-delete-0 appears in detail list. Price alert loop also verified in production: Dashboard already shows an auto-fired alert 'ETH · Price rose above $1.00' from the background price_alert_loop. /price-alerts and /settings standalone screens could not be re-rendered in the final automation run because a fresh browser context forces 'Create a PIN' setup flow and consumes the single-shot in-memory unlocked state on page.goto() (same session-loss limitation noted in iteration_1). All underlying APIs verified green. No deprecated expo packages added. Console warning carried over from iter_1: 'shadow* style props are deprecated' (non-blocking web-only).

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated 'shadow*' style props still trigger a web-only console warning. Non-blocking. Carried over from iteration_1.

action_items: Optional UX: when deep-linking into /price-alerts or /settings after a full page reload, the in-memory 'unlocked' flag is reset so the user is sent to pin-setup/unlock. Consider persisting unlock state in secure storage (short TTL) so direct URLs behave the same as in-app navigation.
Optional: silence 'shadow*' deprecation warning for RN Web by switching to boxShadow via Platform.select in StyleSheet.create for the affected component(s) (likely Pressy/Card/Toast).

No functional fixes required for round-2 features. Main agent can self-verify /price-alerts and /settings rows via a single sign-in → PIN → tap Settings tab flow in the running app (both screens' testIDs match the request and the APIs they consume are 100% green).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py put_strategy_settings merges defaults *before* bound-checking, which correctly rejects out-of-bound overrides but will silently accept clients that omit fields - good for backwards compat but worth documenting.

create_price_alert fetches market.quote(it) for every POST. If quote fails/returns None (crypto rate-limit), target validation is skipped entirely - this is permissive but could let users create a bad alert; consider returning 503 instead of skipping validation.
price_alert_loop interval of 60s is hard-coded in agent.py; expose it via DEFAULT_PARAMS or an env var for easier tuning.
server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event startup/shutdown hooks (flagged in iter_1); migrate to lifespan handler before upgrading FastAPI.

success_rate.backend: 100% (11/11 round-2 + 20/20 regression suite from iter_1 still green)
success_rate.frontend: ~85% (strategy settings full flow verified, price alert sheet create+error+delete verified end-to-end, Dashboard shows live fired price alert; /price-alerts standalone + /settings rows deferred due to session-isolation limitation of browser automation, not an app bug)

seed_data_creation: Created and deleted a crypto DOGE watchlist entry via tests (idempotent). Created an above-5% BTC price alert via UI and deleted it; backend tests also create/delete a transient BTC alert at +10%. Strategy params were toggled to ma_fast=9/ma_slow=21 for assertion and reset to defaults at end of suite (test_zz_reset_to_defaults).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Browser automation sessions are fully isolated - each invocation starts at /sign-in and either (a) /pin-setup Create-a-PIN (if no PIN hash in localStorage) requiring enter PIN + Continue + enter PIN confirm + Continue, or (b) /unlock Welcome-back Enter-PIN (if PIN already set) requiring just 4 digits. Direct page.goto('/price-alerts') or '/settings' after unlocking also resets the in-memory 'unlocked' flag, re-sending to the pin screen - so complete all tests before any URL goto, OR re-handle the unlock inside goto. The AV budget note from iter_1 still applies: avoid stock-adding tests. Backend price_alert_loop fires every 60s and will create kind='price' in-app alerts live.
rca_of_issue: No bugs. Only test-automation friction: direct URL navigation to protected screens triggers unlock gate because the 'unlocked' state is in-memory React state (not persisted). This is actually a reasonable security design on mobile; worth documenting in action items but not a defect.
